content.value_statement: Custom video requests often need planning before animation work begins. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured HyperFrames workflow for design, scenes, audio, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Routes custom video requests when no specialized HyperFrames workflow fits.
Guides discovery for audience, platform, priorities, and variation needs.
Requires design grounding from project specs or HyperFrames creative references.
Plans scenes, rhythm, timing, layout, animation, audio, and transitions.
Explains layout-first composition before adding GSAP motion.
Defines lint, validate, inspect, and preview checks before handoff.
limitations: Best suited for HyperFrames projects and related HeyGen workflows.
Not intended for live data that changes during rendering.
Does not replace specialized workflows when a request clearly matches one.
MP4 rendering is only recommended when the user explicitly requests it.

use_cases.title: Plan a Brand Reel
use_cases.description: Turn an open brand request into a structured HyperFrames concept with scenes, pacing, and visual direction.

use_cases.title: Build a Product Motion Piece
use_cases.description: Create a guided plan for app demos, UI motion, stats, captions, and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Review a Video Composition
use_cases.description: Check layout, animation, audio placement, contrast, and preview readiness before final handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short custom piece.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short HyperFrames video for this topic: [topic]. Ask only for details needed to choose audience, platform, and style.

prompt_templates.title: Shape a Multi-Scene Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a multi-scene HyperFrames composition for [goal]. Include the concept angle, scene structure, rhythm, timing, and asset needs.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Use an existing brand or design specification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the provided design direction to create a HyperFrames video plan. Preserve colors, typography, layout constraints, and motion tone.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Finish a Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this HyperFrames composition for layout, animation, audio, contrast, and validation readiness. Identify required fixes before preview handoff.

output_examples.input: Create a 20 second launch teaser for a developer analytics tool.
output_examples.output: A scene plan with a technical visual concept, pacing notes, motion direction, audio needs, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Add a title card and lower third to an existing HyperFrames piece.
output_examples.output: A focused edit plan that preserves the existing piece and changes only the requested title and lower-third elements.
A checklist covering layout safety, contrast, animation timing, audio mounting, captions, and preview readiness.

best_practices: Confirm the route before building, especially when a specialized workflow may fit better.
Build the most visible layout state before adding animation.
Run validation checks and deliver the stable preview only at handoff.
anti_patterns: Do not add extra scenes, music, or captions unless the request needs them.
Do not invent colors or fonts before reading the design spec or creative references.
Do not treat a static title card as a full multi-scene production.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for custom HyperFrames video work when no specialized workflow clearly fits the request.

faq.question: Does it create the video directly?
faq.answer: It guides the agent through planning, composition, audio handoff, validation, and preview delivery for HyperFrames projects.

faq.question: Can it handle simple edits?
faq.answer: Yes. For small edits, it says to skip planning and make the requested change directly.

faq.question: Does it support audio and captions?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes narrated pieces, music, effects, and captions through the shared media-use audio workflow.

faq.question: What tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects HyperFrames skills and validation tooling, with support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I avoid?
faq.answer: Avoid using it when a specialized video workflow is a better match, or when live render-time data is required.
